encoding: uint16 grey, near = bright, linear in 1/depth: value = 1 + 65534 * (1/d - 1/d_far) / (1/d_near - 1/d_far); 0 = no surface (the view out through the glazing). d = planar depth along the optical axis, metres.
canvas: 2496 x 1664, the image's own canvas (pixel for pixel)

source.rule: clay depth (every proxy), steps snapped to the image (room_depth.snap_edges), then each default product layer's alpha enforced as the depth edge (scratchpad depth_fb17.py)

covers: the frame as rendered with its default products (shell, fixed furniture and product layers)
note: motion-agent, 2026-11-26 (FB17), 0 tokens. For frontend-dev's 2.5D moves (MOCK7). A variant swap changes only its own layer: re-run on that layer if its silhouette differs much from the default.
